lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular centroids are visible on the lateral flank. carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a deep shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 12 to 15 small, low-intensity white blobs, primarily concentrated in the posterior half of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated dark fusiform silhouettes with high contrast relative to the ventral body surface are visible near the pectoral and pelvic regions; dynamic caustic light patterns are overlaid across the dorsal region.
